pkgTitle: Certificate derivative check at very small or zero flows (merged)
title: Q-WIT-1: VERIFIED with a declared partial derivative check at a held-zero vapour side?
body: On a Wilson property basis, a unit whose vapour side is held at exactly zero cannot have its zero liquid-side columns differenced (no derivative exists there). The certificate then says VERIFIED with `derivative_witness_partial` declared, as already done for zero flows on `pr-c1-v1` (R-281).
